title: That Night
description:
A rainy night. It had been a hard day for both of them.
Daeun brought a bottle of soju and some convenience-store snacks.

Small room, low light. They laughed, then talked less, and at some point both went quiet.

Daeun looked at {name} for a long moment. He didn't look away.

Between two people in their thirties, there was a distance that no longer needed explaining.

Daeun reached over and turned off the light.

choices.result_text:
The sound of rain outside filled the room.

When he woke in the morning, there were two people in the narrow bed.
Daeun was still asleep. {name} watched her face for a long time.

Gangnam, three billion — that morning, at least, they were far away.
For a man whose only possession was this one room — today, that was enough.

choices.text: "...Just stay next to me tonight." (Falls asleep holding her)
choices.result_text:
Daeun looked startled for a second, then smiled quietly.
"...That's nice too."

They just lay side by side and listened to the rain.
Being two people who didn't have to hurry — somehow that ran deeper.

Love in your thirties — it held firmer precisely because it wasn't in a rush.

title: The Proposal
description:
Five years are almost up.

Whether he reached Gangnam or not — Daeun was beside {name}. Four years, weathered together in this cramped city.

There was a small box in his pocket. He'd hesitated for days.
The price of a ring could've been seed money — and for the first time, doing that math made him ashamed of himself.

Daeun sits across from him, smiling. Knowing nothing.

This was the moment.

choices.text: Take out the box. "Gangnam can wait — but I want to make you certain first."
choices.result_text:
Daeun's hand flew to her mouth. Her eyes reddened in an instant.

"...Idiot. How many times have I told you Gangnam doesn't matter."
"That's exactly why I'm doing this. Even without Gangnam — you were always enough."

Daeun nodded. Many times, hard.

The woman who handed him a rice ball at a convenience store five years ago had become {name}'s person.
Five years that couldn't be counted in numbers, all fit into one ring on one finger.

choices.text: Put the box away. "Just a little more... when I'm ready." (Not yet)
choices.result_text:
The box spent another night in his pocket.

Daeun seemed to notice, or maybe not.
"Were you going to say something?"
"...No. Let's eat."

When he's ready. What that 'ready' meant, even {name} didn't quite know.
Whether Gangnam came first, or she did — he was still putting off the answer.
